SELECT s.store_id, o.login_state, o.status,
       (f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS line_has_member, (o.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS order_has_member,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
  AND (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IS NOT NULL AND f.channel_id<>1)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS logged_in_lines,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.member_key IS NULL) AS missing_line_member,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.member_key<>o.member_key) AS differing,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.member_key IS NULL AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS line_member_order_none,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.login_state='guest') AS guest_lines,
       MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id=900
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key, login_state,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.sales_line_id, f.member_key AS line_member_key, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT l.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS web_net_before_returns,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_net_line_key,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_net_order_key,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS share_line_key,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS share_order_key,
       MIN(l.business_date) AS mind, MAX(l.business_date) AS maxd
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 8 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_before_returns, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END)/SUM(l.net_amount),1) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
